I have completed the comprehensive visual design review of bainluck.com. 

I've captured desktop and mobile screenshots of all the requested pages, evaluated them against your design dimensions, and compared the site against ESPN, FanDuel, and DataGolf. 

The final report is attached as a Markdown file, and I've also included a ZIP archive containing the report along with all the captured screenshots (desktop, mobile, and competitors).

Key findings show that Bain Luck has an excellent, clean design (especially the Weather and Economics pages), but suffers from some performance issues (loading states on charts) and data density problems on event pages. The full prioritized list of 10 improvements is in the report.
